name: XlObjectSize
description: Specifies the way a chart is scaled to fit on a page.

constants.name: xlFitToPage
constants.description: Print the chart as large as possible, while retaining the chart's height-to-width ratio as shown on the screen.

constants.name: xlFullPage
constants.description: Print the chart to fit the page, adjusting the height-to-width ratio as necessary.

constants.name: xlScreenSize
constants.description: Print the chart the same size as it appears on the screen.
